explication: Heretic is a command-line tool that loads a transformer model, automatically searches abliteration parameters to reduce refusals while preserving behavior, and offers evaluation and model-export actions. The central workflow is CLI orchestration around a mutable model, plugin-based scoring, and Optuna optimization. Separate capabilities include system sizing, model upload/chat/benchmarks, reproduction checks, and residual analysis. README claims guide the capability map; excerpts are partial, so uncertain internal call wiring is omitted.
